name: Vellara Contour Heel
description: A pointed-toe pump with a 7cm heel in matte black smart-fabric upper that shifts texture subtly — smooth at rest, lightly pebbled under warm light. The heel itself is reinforced carbon fiber wrapped in matching fabric. Worn by people who spend long hours on their feet at functions and need the heel to carry them without complaint.
functionality: Smart-fabric adjusts surface texture in response to ambient temperature. Memory-foam footbed reshapes to foot geometry over the first few wears.
what_it_says: You know how to present yourself. Polished, intentional, comfortable enough to stay all night.
story_hooks: The smart-fabric texture shift has been used as a covert signal system — a specific pattern means the room is compromised.
A Tier 5 knockoff exists with an identical appearance but none of the comfort features.
